step3_account_confirmed.step_3_account_confirmed_content:
It is very important to us that all players safeguard their Activision accounts. If your Activision account was hacked and you need help recovering it, please use the questions and steps to provide your account details and submit an account recovery request. If your request is valid, we will work to get you back to playing with your original progress, stats, and content as quickly as possible.

Requests can take up to 24 hours to process. You’ll be notified via email when your request is complete.
step3_account_confirmed.warning_content: ATTENTION: This form is for recovering hacked Activision accounts only. If you're having account linking or unlinking issues, please go to Managing Your Activision Account. For issues that aren't related to account recovery, please visit Support Options.

step4_logged_in.step_4_logged_in_title: You're currently logged in to the following account.
step4_logged_in.step_4_attention_box_content:
ATTENTION:

Your case will be denied if either of the following occurs:

The temporary account is created using a disposable email account or an email account that cannot be verified.
You link a PlayStation, Xbox, or Battle.net account that was not originally linked to your hacked Activision account.
step4_logged_in.step_4_accordion_content:
Follow these steps to link a different account to your temporary account.

1.Go to the LINKED ACCOUNTS section on your temporary account.
2.Select UNLINK next to any accounts you need to unlink.
3.Check the confirmation box and select CONTINUE.
4.Select LINK next to an account you wish to link.
5.You will be taken to the account provider’s website. Follow the steps to log in to the account and complete the account linking process.

step5_create_temp_account.step_5_title_content:
Since you're unable to log in to the account you need help with, you will need to create a temporary Activision account to submit an account recovery request. You will also need to link a PlayStation, Xbox, or Battle.net account that was previously linked to your hacked Activision account.

This temporary account will no longer be accessible after your account is recovered, so please do not make any in-game purchases. Progress and purchases cannot be transferred.
step5_create_temp_account.step_5_small_warning_box_content: We detected that this account was created more than 3 days ago. Please create a new temporary Activision account that will be used to recover your hacked Activision account.
step5_create_temp_account.step_5_attentnion_box_content:
ATTENTION:

Your case will be denied if either of the following occurs:

  • The temporary account is created using a disposable email account or an email account that cannot be verified.
  • You link a PlayStation, Xbox, or Battle.net account that was not originally linked to your hacked Activision account.
step5_create_temp_account.box_list_content:
1. Create a temporary Activision account using a valid email you can access.
  2. When you reach the CONNECTED ACCOUNTS step while creating the account, select an account type (PlayStation, Xbox, or Battle.net) that was linked to your hacked Activision account.
  3. You will be taken to the account provider's website. Follow the steps to log in to the account and complete the account linking process.
  4. Return to this page and select VERIFY TO CONTINUE.
step5_create_temp_account.warning_box_title_text: How to create a temporary Activision account

step_6_link_accounts.step_6_warning_box_content: We do not detect a linked account. Please link a PlayStation, Xbox, or Battle.net account that was previously linked to your hacked Activision account.
step_6_link_accounts.step_6_first_attention_box_content:
ATTENTION:

Your case will be denied if either of the following occurs:

  • The temporary account is created using a disposable email account or an email account that cannot be verified.
  • You link a PlayStation, Xbox, or Battle.net account that was not originally linked to your hacked Activision account.
step_6_link_accounts.step_6_second_attention_box_content:
Follow these steps to link an account to your temporary account.

  1. Go to the LINKED ACCOUNTS section on your temporary account.
  2. Select LINK next to an account you wish to link.
  3. You will be taken to the account provider's website. Follow the steps to log in to the account and complete the account linking process.
  4. Return to this page and select VERIFY TO CONTINUE.
